Name: Better Artisan Style Items for Mizu's Snake
Author: Roseloves109
Description:
Credits to ogs: Mizu for her [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/52015]snake mod[/url] and Comkiens for their [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5394]Better Artisan Goods mod. [/url]

I am back with a new mod that retextures Mizus Snake Items to BAG, I absolutely love Mizu's mod. so i made this mod. Hope you guys enjoy them, let me know if there are any bugs. i fix them ASAP, [b]also please dont forget to endorse the my mod please, so that way more people can see it. It helps inspires me to make mods/unofficial updates. ;)[/b]
